import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod1 = 998244353L;
    static final long mod2 = 1000000007L;
    static final long inf = 2000000007L;
    static final int maxn = 1000004;
    static final int maxm = 204;
    static final int baseVal = 1000000;

    static long n, total;
    static List<Long>[] val = new ArrayList[7];
    static long[] sum = new long[7];
    static long cntA, cntB;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            val[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static long down(long x) {
        return ((x % mod1) + mod1) % mod1;
    }

    static void generate(int depth, int num) {
        val[depth].add(down(cntA - num));
        cntA++;
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            generate(depth + 1, num * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void explore(int depth, long num, long n) {
        if (num > n) return;
        if (num * baseVal + 999999 <= n && num * baseVal * 10 > n) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
                long factor = (long) Math.pow(10, i);
                long tempVal = down(cntB - num * factor + 1);
                List<Long> list = val[i];
                int idx = lowerBound(list, mod1 - tempVal);
                long size = list.size();
                long sumVal = sum[i];
                total = (total + tempVal * size + sumVal - mod2 * (size - idx)) % mod2;
            }
            cntB += cntA;
        } else {
            cntB++;
            total = (total + down(cntB - num)) % mod2;
            int start = (depth == 0) ? 1 : 0;
            for (int i = start; i < 10; i++) {
                explore(depth + 1, num * 10 + i, n);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        generate(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            Collections.sort(val[i]);
            for (long x : val[i]) {
                sum[i] += x;
            }
        }
        cntB = -1;
        total = 0;
        explore(0, 0, n);
        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
